title: Create/wire the FPVBuddy core repository and move the core into it
goal: Batteries, fleet, spares and crash rules live once, in voidbrain/FPVBuddy, behind a storage interface
acceptance: The repository has the core (batteries, fleet, spares, crashes, crash to battery-damage link) with no NERV imports, its own tests, formatter, linter and CI
Its backlog is seeded with: web components for batteries, fleet, spares and crashes; a Claude skill (pilot data file, artifact page); an MCP server with an MCP Apps page, to start when a pilot asks
Tests use invented batteries and drones
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: move pure rules out, add a storage interface and repository tooling. Not a measurement.
